name: Dark Horse Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Dark Horse Technology Group Co., Ltd. provides enterprise services in China and internationally. The company offers industrial acceleration, artificial intelligence, and AI talent services. It also provides comprehensive enterprise service platform integrating enterprise acceleration services; and science and technology innovation and intellectual property services. The company was formerly known as Dark Horse Venture (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Dark Horse Technology Group Co., Ltd. in June 2019. Dark Horse Technology Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2011 and is based in Beijing, China.
